Design and development status

Source: vignettes/articles/design.Rmd
design.Rmd

This page describes the planned design of EarthFlux and the development status of each component. Only the functions marked as available can be used today. All other functions are planned: their names, arguments and behaviour may still change, and none of their results should be used.

Each component is implemented only after its equations, units, domain of validity and test cases are specified and, where possible, verified against the primary sources. The internal specifications are linked below for readers who want the full detail.

Processing chain 

MODIS products            weather stations
      |                         |
 surface state           quality control, reference ET
 (LST, albedo,                  |
  NDVI, LAI, emissivity)  spatial forcing (C1 single station,
      |                    C2 simple interpolation, C3 GWR)
      |                         |
      +------------+------------+
                   |
   METRIC: Rn -> G -> anchor pixels -> rah, dT -> H -> LE
                   |
          ETinst -> ETrF -> ETa  (+ diagnostic flags and provenance)

The use of geographically weighted regression (GWR) for the meteorological forcing is a research hypothesis that EarthFlux is designed to test, not an established result.

Verification status

Status Meaning
Verified The equation was checked against the primary source (equation and page or table).
Candidate Known form, corroborated by secondary sources, pending verification against the primary source.

Components

Radiation (milestone M2)

Function Purpose Status
ef_net_radiation() Surface net radiation Available; candidate (corroborated)
ef_solar_geometry() Solar angles and incidence on sloping terrain Available; calendar terms and hour angle verified (FAO-56), incidence on a tilted plane candidate
ef_air_pressure() Atmospheric pressure from elevation Available; verified (FAO-56, Eq. 7)
ef_tau_sw(), ef_tau_sw_allen(), ef_tau_sw_elevation() Broadband shortwave transmissivity, with beam/diffuse partition ("allen") or from elevation Available; candidate
ef_rs_in(), ef_rs_in_modelled(), ef_rs_in_measured() Incoming shortwave radiation on the pixel plane (slope and aspect), clear-sky or measured Available; candidate
ef_atm_emissivity() Clear-sky atmospheric emissivity Available; candidate
ef_rl_in(), ef_rl_out() Incoming and emitted longwave radiation Available; candidate

Specifications: ef_net_radiation.md, radiation-components.md.

Soil heat flux (M2)

Function Purpose Status
ef_g(), ef_g_bastiaanssen(), ef_g_tasumi() Soil heat flux with an explicit method Available; candidate

Specification: soil-heat-flux.md.

Anchor pixels (M2)

Function Purpose Status
ef_anchor_criteria(), ef_anchor_rule(), ef_homogeneity(), ef_anchor_pick() Explicit, documented selection criteria (no default thresholds) Available; every value is a user choice
ef_select_anchors() Automatic, deterministic and auditable selection of hot and cold pixels Available; candidate
ef_anchors() Anchors chosen explicitly by the user Available
ef_anchor_conditions() Boundary conditions (target LE and H) at the anchors Available; candidate (unit conversion verified)

Specification: anchor-pixels.md.

Sensible heat flux (M2)

Function Purpose Status
ef_zom(), ef_zom_lai(), ef_zom_ndvi(), ef_zom_perrier(), ef_zom_height() Momentum roughness length Available; candidate (ef_zom_height() verified as FAO-56 content)
ef_blending_wind() Wind speed at the blending height Available; candidate
ef_ustar(), ef_rah() Friction velocity and aerodynamic resistance with stability correction Available; candidate (neutral profile verified as FAO-56 content)
ef_air_density() Air density Available; FAO-56 form verified, use in METRIC candidate
ef_ts_datum(), ef_dt_coef() Datum surface temperature and coefficients of dT from the anchors Available; candidate
ef_sensible_heat() Sensible heat flux Available; candidate
ef_h_control(), ef_calibrate_h() Iterative calibration of dT and H with stability correction Available; candidate (open decision SH-11 is an explicit argument)

Specification: sensible-heat.md.

Evapotranspiration (M2)

Function Purpose Status
ef_lambda() Latent heat of vaporization with an explicit method Available; verified (FAO-56)
ef_latent_heat() Latent heat flux as the energy balance residual Available; balance verified (FAO-56)
ef_et_inst() Instantaneous ET from latent heat flux Available; unit conversion verified (FAO-56)
ef_etrf(), ef_et_daily(), ef_et_daily_etrf() Reference ET fraction and daily actual ET Available; candidate (corroborated)
ef_et_period() ET between image dates Planned (later)

Dispatchers (ef_tau_sw(), ef_rs_in(), ef_g(), ef_zom(), ef_et_daily()) take the method as their last argument, with no default, and return a classed list with the values, the method, diagnostic flags and provenance; the method functions return plain numeric values. An end-to-end test runs a synthetic scene through the whole chain.

Specification: evapotranspiration.md.

Weather stations and reference ET (milestone M3)

Function Purpose Status
ef_station_table() Standard station and observation tables (explicit time zone, measurement heights) Planned
ef_station_qc() Station quality control (values are flagged, never deleted) Planned
ef_ref_et() Grass (FAO-56) and alfalfa (ASCE) reference ET, hourly and daily Planned; FAO-56 grass reference verified, alfalfa constants candidate

Specification: weather-forcing.md.

Spatial forcing (M3)

Function Purpose Status
ef_gwr_fit(), ef_gwr_predict() GWR with documented kernel, bandwidth and AICc conventions; block-wise prediction Planned
ef_ols_fit(), ef_idw_fit() Simple spatial alternatives (C2) Planned
ef_station_forcing() Single representative station (C1) Planned

Specification: gwr-forcing.md.

MODIS preprocessing (milestone M4)

Internal functions that read MODIS products, apply scale factors and quality flags, and convert view times to UTC, producing sensor-independent surface variables. Product metadata (layers, scale factors, fill values, quality bits) are verified against the official user guides.

Specification: modis-products.md.

Integrated workflow (milestone M5)

Function Purpose Status
earthflux() Complete workflow built on the same low-level functions, returning all intermediate components, diagnostics and provenance Planned
